WITH af_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 313217
    UNION SELECT 313217
),
first_af AS (
    SELECT co.person_id, MIN(co.condition_start_date) AS af_index_date
    FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
    JOIN af_concepts af ON co.condition_concept_id = af.concept_id
    GROUP BY co.person_id
),
new_af AS (
    SELECT fa.person_id, fa.af_index_date
    FROM first_af fa
    JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id = fa.person_id
      AND fa.af_index_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
      AND op.observation_period_start_date <= DATEADD(day, -365, fa.af_index_date)
),
ac_ingredients AS (
    SELECT 'DOAC' AS class, 43013024 AS ingredient_concept_id UNION ALL
    SELECT 'DOAC', 40241331 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'DOAC', 45775372 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'DOAC', 45892847 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Warfarin', 1310149 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Parenteral anticoagulant', 1367571 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Parenteral anticoagulant', 1301025 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Parenteral anticoagulant', 1301065 UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Parenteral anticoagulant', 1315865
),
ac_concepts AS (
    SELECT class, descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM ac_ingredients i
    JOIN omop.concept_ancestor ca ON ca.ancestor_concept_id = i.ingredient_concept_id
    UNION
    SELECT class, ingredient_concept_id FROM ac_ingredients
),
ac_after_af AS (
    SELECT n.person_id, n.af_index_date, ac.class, de.drug_exposure_start_date AS ac_start_date
    FROM new_af n
    JOIN omop.drug_exposure de ON de.person_id = n.person_id
    JOIN ac_concepts ac ON de.drug_concept_id = ac.concept_id
    WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date BETWEEN n.af_index_date AND DATEADD(day, 30, n.af_index_date)
),
first_ac_date AS (
    SELECT person_id, af_index_date, MIN(ac_start_date) AS first_ac_date
    FROM ac_after_af
    GROUP BY person_id, af_index_date
),
initial_classes AS (
    SELECT f.person_id, f.af_index_date, f.first_ac_date,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT a.class) > 1 THEN 'Multiple classes same day' ELSE MIN(a.class) END AS initial_class
    FROM first_ac_date f
    JOIN ac_after_af a ON a.person_id=f.person_id AND a.ac_start_date=f.first_ac_date
    GROUP BY f.person_id, f.af_index_date, f.first_ac_date
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT i.*
    FROM initial_classes i
    JOIN omop.observation_period op ON op.person_id=i.person_id
      AND i.first_ac_date BETWEEN op.observation_period_start_date AND op.observation_period_end_date
      AND op.observation_period_end_date >= DATEADD(day, 90, i.first_ac_date)
),
stroke_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (4310996,443454,381316,373503)
    UNION SELECT 4310996 UNION SELECT 443454 UNION SELECT 381316 UNION SELECT 373503
),
bleed_concepts AS (
    SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (437312,4081852,192671,439847,376713)
    UNION SELECT 437312 UNION SELECT 4081852 UNION SELECT 192671 UNION SELECT 439847 UNION SELECT 376713
),
outcomes AS (
    SELECT e.person_id, e.initial_class,
           MAX(CASE WHEN sc.concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS stroke_tia_90d,
           MAX(CASE WHEN bc.concept_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bleeding_90d
    FROM eligible e
    LEFT JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co ON co.person_id=e.person_id
      AND co.condition_start_date > e.first_ac_date
      AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day, 90, e.first_ac_date)
    LEFT JOIN stroke_concepts sc ON co.condition_concept_id=sc.concept_id
    LEFT JOIN bleed_concepts bc ON co.condition_concept_id=bc.concept_id
    GROUP BY e.person_id, e.initial_class
)
SELECT initial_class,
       COUNT(*) AS n_patients,
       SUM(stroke_tia_90d) AS stroke_tia_events_90d,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(stroke_tia_90d)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(6,2)) AS stroke_tia_rate_pct,
       SUM(bleeding_90d) AS bleeding_events_90d,
       CAST(100.0*SUM(bleeding_90d)/COUNT(*) AS decimal(6,2)) AS bleeding_rate_pct
FROM outcomes
GROUP BY initial_class
ORDER BY n_patients DESC;

Among patients with incident atrial fibrillation and an anticoagulant started within 30 days, observed 90-day outcomes from initial anticoagulant start were:

| Initial anticoagulant class | N | Stroke/TIA, n (%) | Bleeding, n (%) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|

| Multiple classes same day | 730 | 82 (11.23%) | 81 (11.10%) |
| Warfarin | 398 | 47 (11.81%) | 52 (13.07%) |

Cohort/query definition used:
- New AF = first recorded AF condition, with ≥365 days prior observation.
- Initial anticoagulant = first anticoagulant exposure within 30 days after AF index.
- Classes:
  - DOAC: apixaban, rivaroxaban, dabigatran, edoxaban
  - Warfarin
  - Parenteral: heparin, enoxaparin, dalteparin, fondaparinux
- Follow-up required 90 days after initial anticoagulant.
- Outcomes were condition-code occurrences within 90 days after anticoagulant start:
  - Stroke/TIA: ischemic stroke/cerebral infarction/CVA/transient cerebral ischemia descendants
  - Bleeding: broad bleeding/hemorrhage descendants, including GI and intracranial hemorrhage

Interpretation caveat: these are crude observed EHR rates, not adjusted comparative effectiveness estimates. The high parenteral-anticoagulant rates likely reflect inpatient acuity and confounding by indication.
